title: Horizon Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Designed for high-mileage highway touring and demanding daily commutes, the Apex Horizon Black is engineered to isolate riders from harsh highway buffeting over 800km days. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing a featherweight 1329g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~84 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Comfortable touring helmet with drop-down sun visor.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Optimized for touring comfort with extended cheek pads and adjustable rear rotation; best fit for intermediate oval head shapes.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Apex Horizon Black: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Apex Horizon Black: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Apex Horizon Black. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Apex's Touring lineup, the Horizon Black brings Indian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Apex Horizon Black represents Apex's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~84 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Touring helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Apex Horizon Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
